entries.note: On the road between the towns of the leg, origin first. The tracking API manual's example and an archived reply of the API show it.
Arrived in the town, which follows without a space. Also in the tracking API manual's example.

The planned dispatch date of a leg, with no time. As the waybill's first row it registers the waybill; after the parcel has moved it is in transit, and a date still to come is left out of the history. An archived reply has it where the manual's example has the same leg on the road.
Handed to a courier for delivery.
Returns taken back from the courier: the parcel came back from the delivery round undelivered.
Followed by a colon and the name of the person who took the parcel, which the adapter drops. Also in the tracking API manual's example.

Exception: the accompanying documents were filled in wrongly. Seen with its code in an archived reply of Flip Post's waybill exceptions API, which its API manual also quotes. The adapter does not ask that API.
